subject: Role seniority assessment — hybrid infra position (Anika Rao)
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@greenleaf.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenleaf Recruiting <recruiting@greenleaf.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Level check for Anika Rao — hybrid infra role

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Quick one — we're finalizing an external offer for Anika Rao (ex-Azure infra lead) for the hybrid Infrastructure Engineer position we discussed. Greenleaf's expectation is a "Senior+" level with manager potential. Before we send the formal numbers, could you confirm whether this role should be extended as L5 Senior IC, L5 Manager, or L6 (senior/lead) on Redwood bands?

Context:
- Candidate has 7.5 yrs infra experience, led a 6-person SRE squad, hands-on driver for infra automation.
- Wants a mix of IC/people leadership; prefers "manager" title only if org reports are expected in 6-12 months.

We want to be aggressive on base but align title/band to avoid later re-leveling.

Attaching the JD and a draft comp range from our side. Lmk if you want them routed to compensation.

Thanks,
Daniel

Attachment stubs: draft-jd-Anika.pdf (pdf), greenleaf-proposed-range.xlsx (xls)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Level check for Anika Rao — hybrid infra role

Laura / Tessa — looping you in for quick calibration. My take is: candidate looks like a "transitional" profile between L5 Senior IC and L5 Manager. The deciding factor should be whether Greenleaf expects direct reports immediately. If not, prefer L5 Senior IC with a clear manager-track plan and an accelerated review at 6 months.

Pros for L5 Senior IC:
- Strong hands-on infra chops (reduces onboarding risk for product-critical infra work)
- Avoids precedent of selling "manager" titles without a org need

Pros for L5 Manager:
- Candidate explicitly said they want "manager" if direct reports are part of the job within a year
- May make offer more attractive if compensation is similar

Ask: Laura, can you confirm comp band headroom for L5 vs L6 and whether we have an approved manager-band uplift we can use in exceptions? I can draft a 6-month accelerated growth plan to include in the offer.

— Marcus

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Level check for Anika Rao — hybrid infra role

Marcus / team,

I looked at the comp bands and runway. Short answer: we can support either L5 (Senior IC) or L5 (Manager) financially without exception. L6 (Lead/Staff) would require additional approval and is outside our typical hire profile for this requisition.

Numbers (US, base only, mid-market zone):
- L5 range: $165,000 – $205,000
- L6 range: $200,000 – $250,000 (requires Sr. hiring committee sign-off)

We can add a title-management uplift (manager title at L5) without changing base — common approach is to grant a manager title + written 6-month OKR tied to direct report creation, then review for re-leveling at 6 months. Equity & sign-on can be used to differentiate.

I've attached the comp-band CSV and a template accelerated development plan you can use in the offer. If you want to do L6, I'll route to Rathi for fast-track approval but expect a week delay.

Attachments: comp-band-L4-L6.csv, 6mo-acceleration-plan.docx

- Laura

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Level check for Anika Rao — hybrid infra role

Thanks — HR/comp here. Confirming we can approve an L5 (Manager) title at the standard L5 band. Guidance for the offer:
- Base: target $190k (within band)
- Sign-on: $25k cash (one-time)
- Equity: target 0.35% RSU 4y vesting with 1y cliff
- Bonus: eligible for standard annual bonus plan

If Marcus wants the manager title but wants to restrict direct reports until org needs materialize, we should document a 6-month review and require the manager to have an explicit hiring plan and scorecard. I can sign off on the numbers; Marcus please confirm and I'll prep the formal offer letter.

Karthik
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@gmail.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@greenleaf.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 17:20:00 +0000
Subject: Offer — Redwood Inference (Hybrid Infrastructure) — Anika Rao

Hi Anika and Daniel,

Thanks for your patience — excited to move forward. Based on internal calibration (see thread below), we are prepared to extend an offer at L5 with a Manager title, on the understanding that the role will include IC-heavy deliverables in the first 6 months and a documented 6-month manager-review that ties title and re-leveling to org needs. Summary of the offer terms (high level):

- Title & level: L5 — Manager (subject to 6-month review)
- Base: $190,000
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 0.35% RSU, 4y vesting, 1y cliff
- Bonus: eligible for annual bonus plan; target 10%

Attached is a short offer outline (PDF) and our 6-month accelerated plan template. If these high-level terms look good, we'll send a formal DocuSign offer and calendar time to walk through the manager-review expectations.

On a process note: we chose L5 Manager to be competitive and because Karthik confirmed comp makes sense. We will not commit to immediate direct reports; instead we'll commit to an explicit hiring plan and a targeted leadership onboarding path.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of these high-level terms so Karthik can produce the formal letter (DocuSign link will follow).

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Hiring Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-05-30_Offer_Outline_AnikaRao.pdf
